lines.2: An amusement park nicknamed the island where young people play.
lines.3: It was in Yokohama, next to Matsukasa, so it was fairly close to home.
lines.4: Otome and I were going to have a great time here.
lines.10: 「That's right. I invited both of you.」
lines.11: 「I never said it would be just the two of us, did I?」
lines.13: Sure, but anyone would normally assume a two-person outing.
lines.14: I never expected Otome to pull something this crafty!
lines.15: 「I asked a friend for advice, and they said this would make it easier to invite you both.」
lines.16: 「I didn't lie, but if you feel tricked, then I did something wrong. I'm sorry.」
lines.17: 「N-no... I appreciate that you went to the trouble.」
lines.18: 「Good. To me, you're both dear--one a junior, one like a little brother. I'd like you to get along if possible.」
lines.19: 「So today, have fun and let old grudges wash away.」
lines.20: 「It's sad to keep fighting forever over microcomputers, isn't it?」
lines.22: 「Come on. Let's start with the aquarium.」
lines.26: 「I lied to Otome and told her that's what we were fighting about.」
lines.27: 「What!? Why would you do something like that?」
lines.28: 「I figured if I made it about computers, which she hates, she'd give up on meddling.」
lines.29: 「And instead she went and arranged all this for us.」
lines.30: 「You're seriously an idiot... and you lied on top of it.」
lines.32: 「That attitude really gets on my nerves.」
lines.35: 「Good. We came all this way, so let's enjoy ourselves.」
lines.37: An amusement park with two girls and one guy.
lines.38: Normally I'd be thrilled to have a girl on each arm.
lines.39: But with Konoe here... I wasn't going to enjoy this.
lines.41: She seemed to feel the same way.
